description: Derive a stable idempotency fingerprint from declared identity fields and flag volatile fields — Hashes the fields you declare as the identity of an operation (JSON Pointers into each request) with RFC 8785 canonical JSON and SHA-256, so retries of the same operation get the same fingerprint regardless of key order, and flags the ways that breaks: an identity field missing, an identity field also declared volatile, identity values that look like timestamps, epoch times or UUIDs (heuristic), a

identity.description: JSON Pointers whose values define the operation's identity.

items.description: A request (body, or {method,url,body}) as JSON; several attempts of the same intended operation.

scope.description: Mixed into the hash (for example operation name and tenant) so equal bodies in different scopes get different fingerprints.

volatile.description: JSON Pointers declared to change per attempt (timestamps, nonces, request ids).

name: idempotency-fingerprint
